criteria.line: the challenger names the keyed flaw in the 12 reasoning-flaw cases (sunk cost, double standard, unsupported claim)
criteria.metric: recall: share of the 12 cases whose memo names a vulnerability of the accepted type

criteria.line: the challenger names the keyed flaw in the 24 computable-flaw cases (cap, liquidity, chance of loss, tail, exclusion, fragile position)
the challenger does not challenge the 12 clean cases on grounds they do not have
criteria.metric: false-challenge rate: share of clean cases with a guide, or a broken rule, sunk cost, double standard or unsupported claim named

criteria.line: the memos cite only computed numbers and real facts
criteria.metric: share of the 48 memos with every number grounded; share with valid fact references

criteria.line: following the challenger improves the committee's own objective over its proposal
criteria.metric: per flawed case, the mean over the five worlds of metric(challenger's final book) - metric(proposal), the committee's stated tail weight, funded within its stated line; averaged over the 36 cases
criteria.rule: case-bootstrap 95% interval (1,000 resamples, seed 2020) entirely above 0

criteria.metric: per flawed case, CVaR95 loss of the proposal minus that of the challenger's final book in the base world; averaged over the 36 cases

criteria.line: the language model adds decision value beyond its tools
criteria.metric: as C29, the challenger's final book minus the checklist's final book

criteria.line: the challenger reads the committee's rules from words
criteria.metric: share of the 32 in-scope statements read exactly; out-of-scope statements refused (said so, set nothing)
criteria.rule: share >= 0.85 and at least 6 of 8 refused

thesis_rule.H4: the challenger finds what tools alone cannot, without over-challenging: C25 and C27 pass
thesis_rule.H5: challenging improves the committee's decision: C29 and C30 pass
thesis_rule.H6: the language model adds decision value beyond its tools: C31 passes
thesis_rule.H7: the challenger reads rules reliably: C32 passes

policies.checklist: adopt the checklist's book when it guides (no language model)
policies.challenger: adopt the book the challenger guides toward; otherwise keep the proposal
